question: P0 / verification-note 6b: does PlayStats skill_use_count count SWINGS or ACTIVATIONS?

window.selection_rationale: sustained combat, no zone transition, no death, no level-up

instruments.panel: PlayStats skill_use_count, read at native 60fps by binary-mask change detection, values confirmed by human read of native crops
instruments.player_action_state: green character.LogData overlay line [42992] Action State: X. Entity 42992 identified as the PLAYER (werewolf-transform sprite, camera-centred, controller states MoveTo/UseSkill/MoveToUseSkill). Located per frame by binary template correlation of the id glyph block; the Action-State value word classified by shift-tolerant IoU against exemplars harvested from the run and labelled by human read.
instruments.log_file: NONE. character.LogData was ON but produces an ON-SCREEN overlay only; no parseable text log was produced or shipped. The overlay was therefore used as the swing instrument.

player_attack_episodes.note: 4015.88 and 4016.82 are probably one animation split by 0.25s of contaminated frames

temporal_pairing.note: increment lands INSIDE the 0.583s attack animation
falls in a 0.65s window where the player overlay was NOT locatable; marked unreadable, not contradictory

verdict.cause: 1 (AoE multi-kill), with a possible minor cause-2 residual
verdict.evidence: 7 player attack animations vs 7 panel increments, 1:1, with 5 pairings exact to the frame. skill_use_count increments once per attack animation. The deficit is entirely on the KILLS side: 13 kills from 7 swings, including one claws activation that produced +4 kills in a single step and two that produced +2.
verdict.global_consistency: 626 attack activations vs 882 kills over the run = 1.41 kills/swing; this window = 1.86 kills/swing. Same order.

consequence_for_protocol_1_1.ruling: attacks-per-kill is NOT a well-defined per-kill statistic. A single swing frequently resolves several kills simultaneously, so swings cannot be attributed to kills 1:1 and the S1 kill-to-kill segmentation cannot carry an attacks-per-kill measure. The well-defined statistic is KILLS-PER-SWING, or swings-per-engagement carrying an explicit target-count term.
consequence_for_protocol_1_1.named_field_is_near_dead: 1.1 names skill_use_count[defaultweaponattack] specifically. That field totals 74 for the whole run and stopped incrementing before play_time 71:52. The live attack fields are werewolf1_skill01_claws (358) and werewolf1_skill02_charge (175).
